candidate_claims.text: PM Modi gifts award-winning Indian cheeses, Kashmiri walnut panel to Swiss president --- Photo: @narendramodi/X Listen to this article 0.75x 1x 1.5x 00:00 / 00:00 New Delhi, Oct 5: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday gifted three special Indian cheeses – Gulmarg, Konark and Yeoor – and a hand-carved Kashmiri walnut wood wall panel to Swiss President Guy Parmelin, showcasing India's rich and growing traditions of cheese-making and handicrafts.
It received a Super Gold award at the 2026 Mundial do Queijo do Brasil, an international competition for cheese and dairy products.
It won gold at the 2023 World Cheese Awards in Norway and silver in Switzerland in 2025.
Advertisment Yeoor is a mountain-style cheese inspired by Swiss Gruyere, which is matured for around eight to nine months to develop nutty, sweet and herbaceous flavours.

Railway officials said that the restoration work, which was started in 2023, was being done under the station redevelopment project, which aims to provide better passenger amenities, including separate arrival and departure corridors, bright LED lights, hassle-free access to platforms through escalators, lifts, skywalks and a rainwater harvesting system.
A total of 25 granite benches on the platforms were refurbished.

candidate_promises.text: As a result, the restored facility will provide better civic amenities to long-distance travellers,” said a railway official.
